method: Direct whole-image original, unresampled 1:1 native crops and 256x384 whole-image thumbnail
partial_or_unknown_policy: fail; no inferred hidden endpoints, counts, material identities or causation

observations.owner: same rust skirt and wooden bench seat
observations.evidence: A continuous region of the worn rust skirt bunches into short folds where it lies against the wooden seat/front edge, with a cloth-to-wood contact shadow. This differs from the long hanging folds below. The visible locus is on the image-left side, so the authored left-thigh localization is not exact; the complete source relation is nevertheless present.
observations.claim_limit: The visible contact and compression shape do not measure pressure or prove a mechanical history.

observations.evidence: In the original 1024x1536 image and unresampled cuff crop, the turned cuff has mottled cloth texture and a folded boundary, but individual fine yarn interlacing beside an identifiable stitched edge of that same cuff is not resolved. Hat braiding and jacket grain cannot substitute. Partial/unknown microstructure is fail.

Long narrow ridges and valleys are visible, but they mix with irregular crumpling. The upper skirt edge is concealed beneath jacket/hat and cannot be traced continuously to the hem. Ordinary wrinkles or merely a pleated-skirt impression do not prove every adopted bundle component.

observations.owner: same bob and mustard hat ribbon
observations.evidence: Short strands visibly connect to the bob. The long mustard strip is held on the crown, but its continuity to the encircling hat-band anchor is obscured by the fold/hand, and a shared directional response is not clear: hair fans around the face while the broad ribbon hangs mainly downward with a curl. Similar color, a held fold and loose shapes cannot complete the same-anchor/shared-airflow relation.
observations.claim_limit: A still image cannot prove actual airflow or causal motion.

observations.owner: right needle hand, left pinning hand, one hat
observations.evidence: The left pinning contact is visible, but the raised right fingers pull a golden thread loop/legs rather than clearly gripping one needle. A needle-like line lies near the left pinning fingers. Thread endpoints at the needle eye and one new stitch are not both traceable; older stitch count is also not resolved. The broad repair reads, while exact ownership/endpoints/quantity remain incomplete.

observations.owner: left hand and mustard folded ribbon on same straw crown
observations.evidence: Connected left fingers press the yellow fold directly against the crown; that contact is spatially coherent and separate from the raised opposite hand.

One brass-colored oval ring clearly connects the strap and sewn leather tab on the same bag. The visible strap runs down from the same image-left shoulder to that hip rather than diagonally from the opposite shoulder. The far attachment/ring is not completely exposed; one local good junction cannot prove the complete crossbody route or plural endpoints.

observations.owner: jacket, top, skirt, ribbon, bag and boots
observations.evidence: Moss/olive jacket, ivory vertically ribbed top, rust skirt, mustard ribbon and dark brown bag occupy distinct continuous owners. Lighter rolled inner cuffs differ from the outer sleeve, and plaited straw-like hat texture differs from garment texture. Two leather-looking ankle boots are visible; their shade is medium brown rather than the lighter tan wording, an authorial color drift.
observations.claim_limit: These are rendered appearances. Cotton/fiber composition, authentic leather/straw/brass identity and hidden garment construction are not pixel-proven.

observations.owner: generated foreground face and bob only
observations.evidence: Compared directly with the supplied photograph, the generated figure retains a dark chin-length bob with fine fringe, soft facial contour and natural pink lips. Downward eyelids make exact iris color unobservable. This supports visible face/hair guidance, without identity, actual age, body similarity or biography claims.
observations.component_limit: Dark-eye iris-color fidelity is not separately passed because the downward gaze conceals it.

observations.owner: ferry quay, bench, lap hat and open pouch
observations.evidence: Wet stone, reflective puddles, weathered wood, a mooring bollard, water and the gangway to the ferry form a coherent harbor setting. An open cloth pouch with one visible spool beside the seated person explains the available sewing tool context. Added signage and background people are not requester-owned details.

boundary: Supplemental complete-relation judgments are separate from the exact effective hard-gate set; they are not extra hard gates.
